versos.grego: Καὶ ἤκουσα μεγάλης φωνῆς ἐκ τοῦ ναοῦ λεγούσης τοῖς ἑπτὰ ἀγγέλοις Ὑπάγετε καὶ ἐκχέετε τὰς ἑπτὰ φιάλας τοῦ θυμοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰς τὴν γῆν.

controles.web: I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!”
controles.kjv: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.
controles.livre: E eu ouvi uma grande voz do templo, dizendo aos sete anjos: Ide, e derramai as taças da ira de Deus sobre a terra.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν γῆν· καὶ ἐγένετο ἕλκος κακὸν καὶ πονηρὸν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους τοὺς ἔχοντας τὸ χάραγμα τοῦ θηρίου καὶ τοὺς προσκυνοῦντας τῇ εἰκόνι αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: The first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and evil sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.
controles.kjv: And the first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image.
controles.livre: E foi o primeiro, e derramou sua taça sobre a terra; e se fez uma chaga ruim e maligna nos homens que tinham a marca da besta, e que adoravam a imagem dela.

versos.grego: Καὶ ὁ δεύτερος ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν· καὶ ἐγένετο αἷμα ὡς νεκροῦ, καὶ πᾶσα ψυχὴ ζωῆς ἀπέθανεν, τὰ ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ.

controles.web: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.
controles.kjv: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man: and every living soul died in the sea.
controles.livre: E o segundo anjo derramou sua taça sobre o mar, e este se tornou em sangue como de morto, e toda alma vivente no mar morreu.

versos.grego: Καὶ ὁ τρίτος ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ εἰς τοὺς ποταμοὺς καὶ τὰς πηγὰς τῶν ὑδάτων· καὶ ἐγένετο αἷμα.

controles.web: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.
controles.kjv: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.
controles.livre: E o terceiro anjo derramou sua taça sobre os rios, e sobre as fontes de águas, e se tornaram em sangue.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἤκουσα τοῦ ἀγγέλου τῶν ὑδάτων λέγοντος Δίκαιος εἶ, ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν, ὁ Ὅσιος, ὅτι ταῦτα ἔκρινας,

controles.web: I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You are righteous, who are and who were, you Holy One, because you have judged these things.
controles.kjv: And I heard the angel of the waters say, Thou art righteous, O Lord, which art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus.
controles.livre: E eu ouvi ao anjo das águas, dizendo: Justo és tu, que és, e que eras, o Santo, porque julgaste estas coisas;

versos.grego: ὅτι αἷμα ἁγίων καὶ προφητῶν ἐξέχεαν, καὶ αἷμα αὐτοῖς δέδωκας πεῖν· ἄξιοί εἰσιν.

controles.web: For they poured out the blood of the saints and the prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”
controles.kjv: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.
controles.livre: Porque eles derramaram o sangue dos santos e dos profetas, também tu lhes deste sangue a beber; porque disto eles são merecedores.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἤκουσα τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου λέγοντος Ναί, Κύριε ὁ Θεός ὁ Παντοκράτωρ, ἀληθιναὶ καὶ δίκαιαι αἱ κρίσεις σου.

controles.web: I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.”
controles.kjv: And I heard another out of the altar say, Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are thy judgments.
controles.livre: E ouvi um outro do altar, dizendo: Sim, Senhor Deus Todo-Poderoso, verdadeiros e justos são teus juízos!

versos.grego: Καὶ ὁ τέταρτος ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν ἥλιον· καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ καυματίσαι τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ἐν πυρί.

controles.web: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.
controles.kjv: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire.
controles.livre: E o quarto anjo derramou sua taça sobre o sol; e foi-lhe concedido, que queimasse aos homens com fogo.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐκαυματίσθησαν οἱ ἄνθρωποι καῦμα μέγα, καὶ ἐβλασφήμησαν τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ ἔχοντος τὴν ἐξουσίαν ἐπὶ τὰς πληγὰς ταύτας, καὶ οὐ μετενόησαν δοῦναι αὐτῷ δόξαν.

controles.web: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn’t repent and give him glory.
controles.kjv: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, which hath power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.
controles.livre: E os homens foram queimados com grande calor, e blasfemaram do nome de Deus, que tem poder sobre estas pagas; e eles não se arrependeram, para lhe darem glória.

versos.grego: Καὶ ὁ πέμπτος ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον τοῦ θηρίου· καὶ ἐγένετο ἡ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ ἐσκοτωμένη, καὶ ἐμασῶντο τὰς γλώσσας αὐτῶν ἐκ τοῦ πόνου,

controles.web: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues because of the pain,
controles.kjv: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,
controles.livre: E o quinto anjo derramou sua taça sobre o trono da besta, e seu reino se tornou em trevas, e mordiam de dor suas línguas.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐβλασφήμησαν τὸν Θεὸν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐκ τῶν πόνων αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἑλκῶν αὐτῶν, καὶ οὐ μετενόησαν ἐκ τῶν ἔργων αὐτῶν.

controles.web: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They didn’t repent of their works.
controles.kjv: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.
controles.livre: E eles blasfemaram a Deus do céu por causa de suas dores e por causa de suas chagas; e não se arrependeram de suas obras.

versos.grego: Καὶ ὁ ἕκτος ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν ποταμὸν τὸν μέγαν Εὐφράτην· καὶ ἐξηράνθη τὸ ὕδωρ αὐτοῦ, ἵνα ἑτοιμασθῇ ἡ ὁδὸς τῶν βασιλέων τῶν ἀπὸ ἀνατολῆς ἡλίου.

controles.web: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.
controles.kjv: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.
controles.livre: E o sexto anjo derramou sua taça sobre o grande rio Eufrates; e sua água se secou, para que se preparasse o caminho dos Reis do oriente ,onde o sol nasce.

versos.grego: Καὶ εἶδον ἐκ τοῦ στόματος τοῦ δράκοντος καὶ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος τοῦ θηρίου καὶ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος τοῦ ψευδοπροφήτου πνεύματα τρία ἀκάθαρτα ὡς βάτραχοι·

controles.web: I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, something like frogs;
controles.kjv: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
controles.livre: E da boca do dragão, e da boca da besta, e da boca do falso profeta, eu vi saírem três espíritos imundos, semelhantes a rãs.

versos.grego: εἰσὶν γὰρ πνεύματα δαιμονίων ποιοῦντα σημεῖα, ἃ ἐκπορεύεται ἐπὶ τοὺς βασιλεῖς τῆς οἰκουμένης ὅλης, συναγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν πόλεμον τῆς ἡμέρας τῆς μεγάλης τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ Παντοκράτορος.

controles.web: for they are spirits of demons, performing signs; which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather them together for the war of that great day of God, the Almighty.
controles.kjv: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.
controles.livre: Porque são espíritos de demônios, e fazem sinais sobrenaturais, os quais vão aos reis da terra, e de todo o mundo, para os ajuntarem à batalha daquele grande dia do Deus Todo-Poderoso.

versos.grego: Ἰδοὺ ἔρχομαι ὡς κλέπτης· μακάριος ὁ γρηγορῶν καὶ τηρῶν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ, ἵνα μὴ γυμνὸς περιπατῇ καὶ βλέπωσιν τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: “Behold, I come like a thief. Blessed is he who watches, and keeps his clothes, so that he doesn’t walk naked, and they see his shame.”
controles.kjv: Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.
controles.livre: (Eis que eu venho como ladrão. Bem-aventurado aquele que vigia e guarda suas roupas, para que não ande nu, e vejam seu impudor).

versos.grego: καὶ συνήγαγεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν τόπον τὸν καλούμενον Ἑβραϊστὶ Ἁρμαγεδών.

controles.web: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, Megiddo.
controles.kjv: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.
controles.livre: E foram reunidos no lugar que em hebraico se chama Armagedom.

versos.grego: Καὶ ὁ ἕβδομος ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν ἀέρα· καὶ ἐξῆλθεν φωνὴ μεγάλη ἐκ τοῦ ναοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ θρόνου λέγουσα Γέγονεν.

controles.web: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, “It is done!”
controles.kjv: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.
controles.livre: E o sétimo anjo derramou sua taça sobre o ar; e saiu uma grande voz do templo do céu, do trono, dizendo: Está feito.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγένοντο ἀστραπαὶ καὶ φωναὶ καὶ βρονταί, καὶ σεισμὸς ἐγένετο μέγας, οἷος οὐκ ἐγένετο ἀφ’ οὗ ἄνθρωπος ἐγένετο ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, τηλικοῦτος σεισμὸς οὕτω μέγας.

controles.web: There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since there were men on the earth, so great an earthquake, so mighty.
controles.kjv: And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, and so great.
controles.livre: E houve vozes, e trovões, e relâmpagos; e houve um grande terremoto, o qual nunca tinha acontecido desde que existiam homens sobre a terra, tão forte e grande assim.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγένετο ἡ πόλις ἡ μεγάλη εἰς τρία μέρη, καὶ αἱ πόλεις τῶν ἐθνῶν ἔπεσαν. καὶ Βαβυλὼν ἡ μεγάλη ἐμνήσθη ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ δοῦναι αὐτῇ τὸ ποτήριον τοῦ οἴνου τοῦ θυμοῦ τῆς ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
controles.kjv: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
controles.livre: E a grande cidade se fendeu em três partes, e as cidades das nações caíram; e a grande Babilônia veio em memória diante de Deus, para dar a ela o cálice do vinho da indignação da ira dele.

versos.grego: καὶ πᾶσα νῆσος ἔφυγεν, καὶ ὄρη οὐχ εὑρέθησαν.

controles.web: Every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
controles.kjv: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
controles.livre: E toda ilha fugiu, e os montes não foram achados.

versos.grego: καὶ χάλαζα μεγάλη ὡς ταλαντιαία καταβαίνει ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους· καὶ ἐβλασφήμησαν οἱ ἄνθρωποι τὸν Θεὸν ἐκ τῆς πληγῆς τῆς χαλάζης, ὅτι μεγάλη ἐστὶν ἡ πληγὴ αὐτῆς σφόδρα.

controles.web: Great hailstones, about the weight of a talent, came down out of the sky on people. People blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, for this plague is exceedingly severe.
controles.kjv: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.
controles.livre: E uma grande saraiva, como de peso de um talento, caiu do céu sobre os homens; e os homens blasfemaram a Deus por causa da praga da saraiva, porque a sua praga era muito grande.
